title: Nebius x NVIDIA Global AI Hackathon
description_text: Build a working AI system on open, independent infrastructure, and own the whole thing. The NVIDIA x Nebius Global AI Hackathon is for AI builders, ML engineers, founders, and anyone shipping practical, high-performance AI. You'll build with NVIDIA open source models served on Nebius through Nebius Token Factory, on high performance GPU infrastructure. Experiment with new ideas, push the boundaries of open source AI, and submit a project for a chance to win prizes and recognition. Join fellow builders for technical onboarding, casual workshops, team formation, focused build time, and feedback as you participate in the Global AI Hackathon. Find your nearby city/event here! Requirements The Challenge All submissions must run on either Nebius Token Factory or Nebius AI Cloud and use at least one NVIDIA open source model. Everything else is up to you. What to Build Whether it is an app, agent, or something entirely new, your project should fit into one of the following tracks: Coding and Agentic Engineering TrackBuild coding agents and developer tools: agents that write, run, and test code in Token Factory. Best Apps and Agents Track Build any app or agent someone would actually use, from a productivity tool or copilot to a workflow that runs itself. Power it with Nemotron models on Nebius through Token Factory. Reach for Nemotron 3 Ultra when you need serious reasoning, and let Nano or Super handle the fast, everyday calls, so your app stays responsive and your credits stretch further. We encourage you to deploy your application with Nebius Serverless Endpoints, or use Nebius Serverless Jobs for background processing and asynchronous workflows, though neither is required. Personal AI TrackBuild an always-on, private assistant that works for you while keeping your data under your control. Give it persistent memory, reusable skills, access to the tools and information you choose, and the ability to carry out tasks across your daily workflows. Use at least one NVIDIA open source model, and use tools such as NVIDIA NemoClaw, OpenShell, Hermes Agent, and Nebius Serverless to bring personal AI to assemble, secure, and run your own personal AI system. Physical AI TrackBuild embodied and edge agents that sense and act in the real world: robotics, IoT, and on-device intelligence, powered by Nemotron, GROOT, Cosmos and Sonic models and coordinated through an agent runtime. Use Nebius Serverless Jobs to run simulations, generate synthetic data, evaluate robot policies, or process sensor data at scale, and Nebius Serverless Endpoints to serve real-time inference when needed. Your demonstration video must include at least a 1-minute clip showing the physical hardware/robot actually operating, or — if your project has no physical hardware component — the key application modules in action.

title: JomCode Free Coding Bootcamp - Nov 2026

title: PayPal AI Hackathon
description_text: About the challenge PayPal already moves money for millions of people and businesses, every day, all over the world. This hackathon is us opening that platform up and asking what happens when you put AI behind the wheel. New agents, new ways to pay and get paid, tools nobody's built yet. We want to see what you make of it. AI is changing how people build, buy, sell, work, connect, and move money. Now it's your turn to imagine what comes next. Build What's Next with PayPal and AI is a global online hackathon inviting developers, designers, founders, students, and builders to create something new using PayPal and AI. There are no prescribed problem statements and no set of tracks. Build an agent, an app, an automation, a new payment experience, a business tool, a social product, or something we haven't thought of yet. The only fundamental requirement: your project must meaningfully use both PayPal and AI. Why Join? Build something ambitious — Turn an idea into a working project using PayPal and AI. Explore what’s next — Experiment with new ways people, businesses, and AI agents can interact with money and payments. Win part of $69,750 in total prizes — Compete for overall prizes and special awards across creativity, impact, execution, and more. Show what you can build — Put your project in front of PayPal judges, developers, and the wider hackathon community. Learn by building — Explore PayPal APIs, AI tools, agents, automations, and emerging development workflows. Build your way — Join individually or as a team, and start something new or meaningfully advance an existing project.

title: ASEAN Cyber Security School 2026: Online Action Learning for Students and Young Professionals

title: Asia Student App Challenge Malaysia by SwiftLah!
description_text: The wait is over! We’re excited to announce that SwiftLah! Community is collaborating with Swift Students Cafe and STDCx to bring the Asia Student App Challenge to Malaysia! 🎉 💡 What is Asia Student App Challenge? It’s an opportunity for students to turn their ideas into apps! The challenge is simple: build an app using Swift with Xcode or Swift Playground that can be experienced in just 3 minutes, works completely offline, and demonstrates innovation, creativity, social impact, or inclusivity. And here’s the best part, you don’t need any prior coding or design experience to participate! ✨ What you can look forward to: •⁠ ⁠💻 Build your own app from scratch. •⁠ ⁠💡 Explore your creativity and bring your ideas to life. •⁠ ⁠🤝 Receive feedback to help you improve your project. •⁠ ⁠🏆 Stand a chance to win an exclusive pin and special gifts!👩‍🎓 Who can participate? This challenge is open to students and recent graduates in Malaysia who meet one of the following requirements: •⁠ ⁠🎓 Are currently enrolled in an accredited academic institution; or •⁠ ⁠🎓 Graduated from an accredited academic institution within the past six months, whether they’re continuing their studies or have entered the workforce. If you meet either of these requirements, this is your chance to bring your ideas to life and explore what’s possible with app development! 🚀 You’ll need a Mac or iPad capable of running Xcode or Swift Playground.
